{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZaudjQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhDCDN8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 79, "title": "Separate stable synthetic identities from handles in OLT displays", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `b7c584399b8d83fcaf0dfa96140cb5b11acff045`, `src/olt.ts` identifies speakers, attendees and presence events only by mutable handles. `TerminalOlt.who` and `line` also fall back to internal member keys when lookup fails. Members sharing a handle therefore have indistinguishable presentation.

The reproduced 1997 judgment describes member IDs as displayed when transmitting, separately from optional handles. This supports correcting speech attribution under an explicit continuity assumption from the documented earlier service to November 1996. It does not authenticate target-year geometry. [Judgment reproduction](https://www.law.co.jp/cases/pcvan.htm)

## Expected outcome

OLT speech displays a stable synthetic identity separately from the current safe handle. Reuse the same token for that member in attendance and identity-bearing arrival/departure lines, making cross-service recognition possible after renames and with duplicate handles.

Reuse the existing forum token algorithm and name fallback unchanged through a small shared presentation helper. Preserve the `pcvan-forum-v1:` namespace, full-ID UTF-8 input, FNV-1a/64 calculation and `SYN-` base-32 output. No persisted identity field or schema migration is needed.

## Context

Reproduce through the existing reconstructed route: MAIN → 13 → 2 → OLT → JOIN 2; inspect `/WHO`, speak, rename through `/HANDLE`, and reread with `/LIST`. Currently only handles appear; expected output includes an independent stable token. These are existing product controls, not newly authenticated historical commands.

Historical evidence inspected 2026-10-24:

- The [judgment reproduction](https://www.law.co.jp/cases/pcvan.htm), dated 1997-12-22 and describing March 1994 OLT activity, distinguishes transmitted IDs from optional handles and describes handle-bearing presence notices. Confidence is high in the displayed transcription, moderate in its historical use because the publisher disclaims guaranteed accuracy. The original and omitted transcript annex were not recovered. IDs in attendance/notices, exact placement and 1996 continuity remain reconstruction assumptions.
- [Author-preserved August 1996 forum headers](https://someya.sakura.ne.jp/poem/tansi/tansimain.html) independently separate parenthesized tokens from pen names. Confidence is high in that observed distinction; another SIG's later preservation with encoding damage cannot establish OLT formatting or rename policy.
- The [まいとーく author description](https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/win95/net/se024554.html) separately describes ID-to-handle lookup and OLT attendance/participation. Its release date is unresolved; client capabilities do not authenticate host layout.

Accepted reconstruction: retain the current OLT timestamp, speech delimiters and presence wording, adding a separate parenthesized synthetic token. Use the current safe handle when rendering existing lines; do not rewrite earlier terminal scrollback. Attendance and presence token placement are consistency choices, not recovered historical formatting.

Implementation: `src/forums.ts` owns `identityToken`, `penName` and `renderPost`; `src/olt.ts` owns OLT presentation. Preserve forum output byte-for-byte, including its fixture-only DEMO exception. Do not extend that exception to OLT. `src/olt-state.ts:validateOltMembers` already rejects unresolved persisted OLT references: missing-member presentation is defensive behavior, not grounds to weaken validation.

This extends [OLT #53](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/53) and the forum-only identity correction [#71](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/71). Live open-Issue/PR searches found no items; bounded history searches found no equivalent pending work. [PR #78](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/78) and `docs/validation.md` report 272 passing checks including configured type checking/build. Those are Coordinator records; this graph ran no checks.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Show matching token and separate safe handle in human/resident speech, recent-history rendering, room attendance, directory WHO output and existing member-attributed presence events. Preserve participant counts and quiet/anonymous visits; generic exit confirmations need no identity field.
- [ ] Tokens match forum output for the same member and remain stable across rename, member ordering, rereading, reload and JSON restore. Preserve existing forum known-token assertions and DEMO/missing-author behavior.
- [ ] Reuse the existing trimmed-name rules and `名無し` fallback. Unresolved OLT members display `不明` and `名無し`, without using raw keys as labels or inventing members. Test this through a presentation fixture/stub; retain rejection of invalid stored references. Preserve literal speech text, including text that happens to resemble markup or keys.
- [ ] Keep changes confined to presentation and directly affected documentation/tests. Preserve IDs, author references, text, timestamps/calendar projection, ordering, retention, room state, presence scheduling, inference prompts, privacy, consent, budgets, cancellation and cross-tab arbitration. Label computation introduces no writes; ordinary presence operations retain their existing writes.
- [ ] Extend existing Playwright coverage for human/resident labels, duplicate handles, renames, token agreement with forums, unusable names, defensive missing members and all three line kinds. Include a production-browser speak → WHO → rename → LIST → reload/restore journey, literal rendering/log export and keyboard-accessible scrolling/input at 320px. Use existing fake-time and mocked-model helpers; no real inference or model download is needed.
- [ ] Preserve existing OLT lifecycle, storage/import/reset, privacy, consent, IME, terminal and forum regression coverage. Verify projection does not mutate supplied records; restore tests retain strict validation and original attribution.
- [ ] Update README, `docs/research/pcvan-1996-1997.md` and existing Settings/About descriptions with these sources, access date, confidence and reconstruction limits. Qualify the earlier blanket uncertainty about OLT identity while retaining unknown commands/layout. Keep provenance explanations outside routine chat.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs documented `npm test`, which includes configured TypeScript checking and production build, and records actual results. Review the full diff, affected documentation links and `git diff --check`; use existing tooling.

## Optional validation

Compare another dated OLT capture if one becomes accessible. Exact spacing, subjective nostalgic review and physical/native-IME checks are not completion gates.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. All acceptance checks are achievable before merge.
